description: Heavy tar opioid, cut with whatever was nearby. The deepest nod there is.

overdose.message: The nod goes all the way down and does not turn around.

phases.end_message: You surface, gasping, into a world that got worse while you were gone.
phases.peak_message: You go under. The tar closes over your head, black and total and perfect.

withdrawal.message: Withdrawal has you by the spine. You would trade almost anything to make it stop.

effects.comeon_message: It is in you. Now the part nobody talks about — the waiting.
effects.onset_message: It arrives all at once, warm and enormous, and the waiting stops mattering.

name: Blacktar
